probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Your Website Title Go to homepage For sale To rent Neighbourhoods Agents About Overview Buy Quartiere Menu Close For sale 5 homes To rent 5 homes Neighbourhoods 5 guides Our agents 6 agents Sell your property Free valuation Featured home Beachfront Bliss 456 Palm Avenue, California Price $750,000 About us News Contact Book a visit Offices in Mariehamn, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Milan, Barcelona, Helsinki Book a visit Quartiere / Real Estate Since 2006 A real estate house built on local knowledge We started with one office on the harbour and one rule: know the street before you sell the house. Quartiere opened in Mariehamn in 2006, selling summer houses to families who had rented them for years. Today we sell and let homes in six cities, from canal apartments in Copenhagen to garden flats in Milan, and every office still works the same way: small teams, one neighbourhood each, and an agent who will be there from the first viewing to the last key.
